name: Quotas
description: Per-user / per-role request quotas. Caps how many movies or TV shows each user can request within a sliding window (hour / day / week / month).
author: Arediss

capabilityReasons.users:read: Resolves a user's role to pick the policy that applies, and lists users for the admin overview.
capabilityReasons.settings:plugin: Stores policies and overrides in the plugin data dir.
capabilityReasons.requests:read: Counts the user's recent requests to enforce the quota.
capabilityReasons.permissions: Registers an admin-only permission gate for the management routes.
